limits: Helper animation/input/contact identity was not recorded. Source supports a slide script, but the exact attacking helper and executed instruction are not directly measured.

Only native file 0, Area Keys ON, ability gating OFF, fixed retail sources, qualified 730 door entry and this finite timing were exercised. One HP 1 run is not an independently repeated all-health guarantee.
